# Digital Gloss

> Digital Gloss is a website design and development studio in Abu Dhabi, UAE, serving start-ups, small businesses and independent consultants in the UAE and worldwide. Everything is explained in plain English, without technical jargon.

## What we do

- [Services](https://digital-gloss.com/services.html): Website design and development; content development; brand identity; domain and hosting; website maintenance; SEO and AI search optimisation; business email addresses.
- [About](https://digital-gloss.com/about.html): who we are and how we work.
- [FAQ](https://digital-gloss.com/faq.html): website cost, the Gloss Guarantee, hosting, support, templates and performance.
- Concept work: three self-initiated concept websites for fictional brands (property, restaurant, wellness), linked from the home page.
- [Contact](https://digital-gloss.com/contact.html): start a project by phone, WhatsApp, email or enquiry form.

## Facts

- Company: Digital Gloss Technology Solutions LLC SPC
- Location: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
- Email: solutions@digital-gloss.com
- Phone: +971 55 581 0759
- Pricing: fixed project prices agreed after a free consultation. Websites from AED 4,900 (Launch), AED 8,900 (Growth) and AED 14,900 (Signature); full list at https://digital-gloss.com/services.html#pricing
- The Gloss Guarantee: fixed price; design refined until the client is happy, with the deposit refunded if they are still not happy after two rounds; three months of free maintenance if an agreed launch date is missed.
- Websites are custom designed, not templates.
